Does NoCharge V2 save game scores?

Short answer: the current V2 source does not persist game scores or provide a score-history dashboard. This code-behavior note is not a privacy policy.

By NoCharge·Reviewed by NoCharge·Published August 19, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read
Check the current platform.

Use the public pages behind this explanation.

Open the ArcadeReview PrivacyKeyboard-only play notes

Short answer: NoCharge V2 does not provide a saved-score dashboard, cross-device score sync, or a game-history account. Scores, move counts, and boards shown during play belong to the active page session; the current game source does not write those results to browser storage.

What is retained locally

The theme providers use browser storage for the base theme preference and seasonal-mode preference. Those values control the interface palette; they are not game results. The current code does not provide a NoCharge account or server-side score service.

What this does not settle

This is a description of the behavior visible in the V2 source, not a complete inventory of every browser or network behavior and not legal advice. The Privacy page describes current V2 site behavior; this article remains a narrow source-code note rather than a complete policy.

For the exact scope of the read-only diagnostic tool, see what NoCharge V2 stores in your browser and the Storage Inspector.
